description: This file implements a localization bundle for the Mattermost plugin API, including functions to initialize message bundles, retrieve localizers for users and server, and localize messages with error handling.

classes.name: PluginAPI
classes.description: Interface for plugin API to manage translations, including methods for retrieving bundle path, config, user info, and logging warnings.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Type alias for i18n.Message, representing a localizable message.

classes.name: LocalizeConfig
classes.description: Type alias for i18n.LocalizeConfig, used to configure localization calls.

classes.name: Localizer
classes.description: Type alias for i18n.Localizer, providing methods to localize messages.

classes.name: Bundle
classes.description: Struct that embeds i18n.Bundle and includes an API reference; manages message bundles and localization.

methods.name: InitBundle
methods.description: Initializes a message bundle by loading localization files from a specified directory, excluding 'active.en.json'.

methods.name: GetUserLocalizer
methods.description: Returns a localizer for a specific user based on their locale; falls back to server locale on error.

methods.name: GetServerLocalizer
methods.description: Returns a localizer for the default server locale.

methods.name: LocalizeDefaultMessage
methods.description: Localizes a message; returns empty string if localization fails, with warning logged.

methods.name: LocalizeWithConfig
methods.description: Localizes a message with a given configuration; returns empty string if localization fails, with warning logged.
